text:
Brady Tkachuk had back-to-back hat tricks in mid-October, then scored in his first trip back to Ottawa as a Panther (a 5-1 loss). His brother Matthew later said the return "was not a sellout," per TSN's headline, disputing the Senators' count. It has been a lot of story for 16 games.

The hockey has been just as loud. He has 17 points, 16 of them in his last ten, and 12 on the power play. Our form verdict calls it earned: Florida creates far more with him on the ice (16.2 on-ice expected goals in that span against 12.8 usual) and owns 58% of the five-on-five chances. He is also hitting everything, 66 times in 16 games.

Since the hat tricks the goals have slowed, two in eight games, and some of the power-play share will fade. But Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking flags a signature worth watching: 19% of his setups come from behind the net, more than twice a typical forward's rate. Our projection: around 77 points.
headline: Brady Tkachuk, settling in as a Panther
